title: A small-team platform effort worksheet
method: Synthetic four-week capacity of 640 hours. The first three categories are disjoint and total96 hours, or15%. The forty-hour alternative is a separate estimate, not another component of the Kubernetes total.
alt: A small-team platform effort worksheet: Upgrade and maintenance 48 engineering hours, Developer support 32 engineering hours, Recovery rehearsal 16 engineering hours, Simpler option estimate 40 engineering hours. Illustrative inputs.
